canonical_queue.binding_basis: The six rendered titles match TZ01 C01-C06 exactly and do not match the TP title sequence.

materiality_test.substantive_definition: A deviation is substantive when it can materially change the reader understanding of the finding, evidence weight, uncertainty, scope, provenance, causal boundary or decision ceiling.
materiality_test.presentation_only_handling: Record presentation-only deviations in historical_text_comparison; they do not block publication or alter the derived reader outcome.

audit_policy.content_truth_track: Before rendering, compare the proposed card content with the resolved primary PDF and check both factual accuracy and material omissions across the reader contract.
audit_policy.render_fidelity_track: After rendering, compare the image with the approved specification and reader contract. Paraphrase, abbreviation, layout labels and non-claim decoration pass unless they introduce a substantive error or misleading data geometry.
audit_policy.engineering_conformance_track: JSON exactness rules are purpose-scoped guardrails. A required object, relation, exact_once or unlisted-text deviation is blocking only when it protects substantive truth or source traceability and the deviation is material.
audit_policy.historical_text_comparison_track: Historical wording comparison records equivalent wording or wording divergence without pass/fail language and has zero weight in the science-communication verdict.
global_constraints_checked: no pooled prevalence or causal effect
no summing overlapping cause categories as mutually exclusive
no efficacy ranking of mitigation strategies
no trusted reuse of PRISMA n=8533

derived_reader_outcome.interpretation: All five reader-contract dimensions are communicated; no card contains a substantive render-fidelity failure.

summary.interpretation: All six cards preserve the evidence weight, limitations, scope and non-causal decision boundary. Decorative list numerals and wording differences are presentation choices, not scientific failures.

cards.title: 缺藥研究有 56 篇，但不能合成單一全球比例
visible_text: HIV 27｜瘧疾 20｜結核 9
40 篇來自撒哈拉以南非洲
55 篇接受 JBI 評讀：低風險 32｜中等 22｜高風險 1
研究設計、缺藥定義與結果高度異質，因此採敘事整合
研究數不是缺藥盛行率；地理集中限制外推。
標籤與框線表示內容功能；小標記表示證據狀態。
cards.main_visual_scene: 以 HIV、瘧疾、結核三個疾病計畫模組圍繞一疊異質研究證據；旁側以非比例式非洲地理標記提示證據集中，不畫圓餅圖或全球盛行率儀表。

differences: Unlisted visible labels inside the paper stack: 異質研究證據、研究設計、缺藥定義、結果指標.

cards.title: 缺藥問題，主要卡在系統
visible_text: 供應鏈／庫存：28 篇
治理：8｜預測／規劃：6
原因類別可在同一研究重疊
作者的敘事綜合，非因果估計。
cards.main_visual_scene: 用五個可重疊的系統節點呈現供應鏈、採購、資金、治理、預測；以虛線關聯連到中央缺藥箱，明示類別重疊，不用圓餅圖、不使用因果實線箭頭。

differences: The central box adds 缺藥 as a separate visible label although it is not a listed visible_text item.
Approved count phrases are duplicated in node labels and the lower legend rather than rendered once as the supplied strings.

cards.title: 缺藥怎麼一路傷到病人？
visible_text: 上游：政策／採購／資金問題｜中層：供應中斷｜下游：治療延遲或中斷
報告的後果包括依從性變差、療效變差、抗藥性與疾病惡化
象牙海岸 HIV 隊列：11% 因缺藥出現治療缺口或換藥
象牙海岸單一 HIV 隊列。跨研究多為觀察性證據。
cards.main_visual_scene: 三層垂直框架：上游政策與供應、中層服務中斷、下游病人後果；層與層只用虛線導引表示回顧中的關聯鏈，旁置 HIV 單一隊列的小型證據標記。

differences: The combined upstream-middle-downstream sentence is split and each fragment is duplicated as a heading and body line.
Rx is rendered on the medicine bottle without visible-text authorisation.

cards.title: 缺貨的帳單，病人和系統一起付
visible_text: 病人：跨區求藥、私人購藥、交通與自費增加
系統：緊急採購、替代藥、庫存失衡與浪費
泛美調查：46% 抗反轉錄病毒缺貨事件觸發緊急採購
泛美抗反轉錄病毒事件調查。不可外推成全球比例。
cards.main_visual_scene: 中央缺貨藥架，左側是病人的交通與自費負擔，右側是醫療系統的緊急採購與庫存壓力；用兩側負擔而非單向因果流程。

differences: Scene decoration adds multiple unlisted labels, including 缺貨、庫存狀態、自費明細、藥費、交通、其他、合計、私人藥局、緊急採購、採購申請 and 替代藥.

cards.title: 從救火，轉向能預警的供應鏈
visible_text: 短期：緊急採購／調貨、優先排序、替代方案、轉介
長期：緩衝庫存、多元供應、穩定融資、治理與物流資訊系統
SMS／電子回報可協助早期發現與重新分配
敘事性時間趨勢，非正式時間序列分析。策略不是效果排名。
cards.main_visual_scene: 左右雙欄：左為短期救火工具箱，右為長期韌性供應鏈；中間只用虛線轉換導引。電子庫存回報以簡潔手機與倉儲訊號呈現，不畫療效排名。

differences: The two authorised list sentences are rewritten into eight separately prefixed short-term and long-term labels.
The priority-list illustration renders 1, 2 and 3 although this card authorises no visible numbers.

cards.title: 方向一致，但證據還不夠硬
visible_text: 缺乏嚴格量化病人結果，TB／瘧疾尤其不足
經濟成本研究很少
不同研究方法與缺藥定義差異大
PRISMA 流程數字有內部不一致
僅作審計警示。缺乏量化不等於沒有危害。
cards.main_visual_scene: 研究證據文件在放大鏡下顯示方法異質、經濟資料缺口與 PRISMA 稽核警示；以缺口框與不確定性標記呈現，不重畫有問題的 PRISMA 數字。

differences: Unlisted scene labels include 研究證據文件、方法異質性、缺藥定義不同、量化結果不足 and 經濟成本研究.
The audit clipboard adds 審計檢視、PRISMA 流程、????、數字有內部不一致 and 不採納為確定數字 instead of limiting text to the authorised sentence.

reader_contract.central_claim: Medicine stock-outs in low- and middle-income settings recur through interacting upstream, supply-chain and downstream system drivers; the review maps these patterns but cannot establish global rates, causal rankings or a universally effective remedy.
reader_contract.evidence_weight: A heterogeneous narrative systematic review maps recurring system drivers but does not estimate one pooled global effect or prevalence.
reader_contract.limitations: Definitions, designs and settings differ; quantitative patient outcomes and economic evidence are sparse.
reader_contract.applicability: Evidence is geographically concentrated and local or regional percentages remain bound to their source settings.
reader_contract.misuse_boundaries: Reported driver frequencies and observed harms are associations, not ranked causal effects. Do not claim a global stock-out rate or that one strategy has been proven to eliminate stock-outs everywhere.
